content: Lakpanbwɛ
Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɩbwɛ́bwɛ́ɛ́bwɛ́ á, tɔkʋ bɛ́ha nyankpʋsa ɔbɔ́bwɛ lakpan, támɛ ɔhá ánɩ́ ɩna mʋsʋ mʋ ba lɔ́bwɛ lakpan ɔgyɔ́wɩ nɩ́.
Nɩ́ ɔkʋ lɛ́ha ahá ánfɩ bʋmɔkʋ́dan mɩ́sʋ́ hógyitɔ ánfɩtɔ ɔkʋ lɔ́bwɛ lakpan á, nɩ́ bɛda nfúókwɛbʋ síán mʋ ɔmɛtɔ, tswɩ mʋ wá ɔpʋ okluklúkpá pó á, ɩbʋ alɛ́ dʋn.
Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩkɩ mlɩ ɩwɩ wankláán. “Nɩ́ fʋ́ bá ɔpʋ́ ɩlá gyi fʋ á, wa ɩyɩn wa mʋ. Nɩ́ ɔlɛdamlí klʋntɔ á, sikie mʋ.
Nɩ́ ɔlɔpʋ ɩlá gyi fʋ tse sienɔ́
ɛkɛwʋ́lɛ owítɔ́, ɔlɛla bobwií ɩpa há fʋ́ á, sikie mʋ.”
Hógyi
Yesu sumbí ayɔpʋ́ ámʋ bɛbláa mʋ bɛɛ, “Ha anɩ hógyi imoni tsɩa.”
Yesu lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ mlɩ hógyi lómoní fɛ́ takyí-akpin ibí á, mlɛ́talɩ́ bláa kɛlɩ ánfɩ mlɩaa, ‘Puli yɛlɩɩ́ ɔpʋtɔ.’ Ɩbɔ́bwɛ dɩ́nká mʋ́sʋ́.
Osúmpʋ́ Gyumagyihɛ
“Nɩ́ mlɩtɔ ɔkʋ bʋ osúmpʋ́á ɔtɔyɔ́ agyʋ́má mʋ ndɔtɔ ntɛ́ɛ ɔtɛkɩ mʋ akúfasʋ, otsú agyʋ́mátɔ́ ba a, bláa mʋ wie tɛbláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Wa ɔsa bwɛ afʋgyi atɔ́?’ Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ!
Bláa ɔtɛbláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Tsu tati saba, afʋbɔtswɩ ɔpʋ́nʋ́ ha mɩ. Bɛlɩɩ́ mɩ́ angyi atɔ́. Negyi ta á, fayégyi fʋ́ klɛ́.’
Ɔtɛdá osúmpʋ́ amʋ ɩpán ɔbɛ́ɛ, alabwɛ́ tɔ́á mɔwa mʋ bwɛ? Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ!
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ nɩ́ mlɩ ɛ́ mlɔbwɛ́ tɔ́á bɔwa mlɩ bwɛ tá á, mlɩblɩ mlɩaa, ‘Asúmpʋ́ kɛkɛ anɩgyí. Tɔ́á igyi anɩ bwɛhɛ́ anɩlabwɛ́ á.’ ”
Ɩlɔ Pɛpɛ Alɔpʋ́ Dú Tsa
Yesu ná Samaria pʋ́ Galileafɔ ɔkasʋ ɔyɔ́ Yerusalem.
Brɛ́á ɔlɛta wúlu kʋsʋ wie tá á, ɩlɔ pɛpɛ alɔpʋ́ dú akʋ bʋna bɛbá befia mʋ, besi lɩɩ́ tsútsú.
Ɩnʋ bɔkplʋ́n blɩ́ bɛɛ, “Yesu! Owíé! Wun anɩ nwɛ.”
Yesu lótsu ansɩ́ kɩ amʋ́, ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩpʋ mlɩ ɩwɩ yosuná Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́.
” Brɛ́á bɔpʋ ɔkpa bɔyɔ́ á, amʋ́ ɩwɩ lɛ́plɩ.
Ɔkʋlɛ mʋ́ lówun ánɩ́ mʋ ɩwɩ laplɩ́ɩ a, oleyinkí ɔdɛkplʋ́n kanfʋ́ Bulu kʋ́klʋ́kʋ́ʋ́.
Olebemlí bún Yesu ayabitɔ, ɔdɛ mʋ ɩpán da. Samariayin oyin ánfɩ gyí.
Ɩnʋ Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Megyí ahá idú natsá? Mʋ́ kwebá atráhɛ mɛ́?
Mʋ́ sʋ amʋ́tɔ́ ɔkʋkʋ mɛ́ba bɛkanfʋ́ Bulu dʋn Samariayin ɔfɔɔ́ ánfɩ nkʋlɛ?”
Ɩnʋ ɔlɛbláa oyin ámʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Kʋsʋ natɩ. Fʋ́ hógyi latsá fʋ́ ɩlɔ.”
Bulu Iwíegyí Ámʋ Ɩbá
Farisifɔ akʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ Yesu bɛɛ, “Ɔmɛnkɛ Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ ɩbɛ́ba?” Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Megyí tɔ́á ɔha ɔbɔ́pʋ ansíbi wun Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ igyi.
Ɔhaa mɛ́ɛtalɩ́ blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Kɩ, mʋ́bʋ nfɩ.’ Ntɛ́ɛ ‘Mʋ́bʋ nána á.’ Tsúfɛ́ mlɩ klʋntɔ Bulu iwíegyí amʋ bʋ.”
Ɩnʋ Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɛkɛ ɔkʋ ɩbá, mlódunká ánɩ́ mlówun mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ ɛkɛwʋ́lɛ pɛ́, támɛ mlɩmóowun mʋ́.
Ahá bɛ́bláa mlɩ bɛɛ, ‘Ɔbʋ nfɩ.’ ntɛ́ɛ ‘Ɔbʋ nána,’ támɛ mlɩmásrɩ́ buo amʋ́ yɛ́kɩ.
Tsúfɛ́ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ ɔbákɛ bɔ́bwɛ fɛ́ alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ nyankpʋ tɔfwɩ́ ɩbɩ, bʋtowun mʋ́ nsaɩntɔ fɛ́ɛ́ ámʋ.
Támɛ négyankpá wun ɩwɩɔsɩn tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ, ndɛmba-abí ánfɩ ɛ́ békiná mɩ́.
Alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ ilegyi Noa brɛ́sʋ́ amʋ a, alɩ́ ibégyi mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ ɛ́ ɩbábɩ nɩ.
Ahá betsiá, bʋdɛ atɔ́ gyí, bʋdɛ ntá núu; bʋdɛ aká tsiá, bʋdɛ atsɩ kɩ́tá há akúlu alɩɩ yɔ́fʋn ɛkɛá Noa lówie mʋ dáka kpɔnkpɔntɩ ámʋtɔ, ntsu lɔ́bʋlá bɔmɔ amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́.
Alɩ kɛ́n ɩlɛba Lot ɛ́ brɛ́sʋ́ nɩ. Ahá betsiá, bʋdɛ atɔ́ gyí, bʋdɛ ntá núu, bʋdɛ atɔ́ hɔ́ɔ, bʋdɛ atɔ́ fɛ; bʋdɛ atɔ́ du, bʋdɛ ibu yíi,
yɔ́fʋn ɛkɛá Lot lɛ́dalɩ Sodom wúlutɔ, ogyá mʋ́a atonkodu lotswie tsu ɔsʋ́sʋ́ bɛhɩ amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́.
Alɩ́ kɛ́n mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ ɩwɩɔwanlɛkɛ́ bófwie ahátɔ nɩ́.
“Ɛkɛ ámʋ a, ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔdɩn obusʋ, mʋ atɔ́ ɩbʋ obuto ɔmákplɩ́ botsu tɔtɔ. Alɩ kɛ́n ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔbʋ ndɔtɔ ɛ́ máyinkí botsu tɔtɔ nɩ.
Mlɩkaɩn Lot mʋ ka asʋ́nsʋ́!
Tsúfɛ́ nɩ́ ɔkʋ lódunká ánɩ́ ɔbɛ́prɩ mʋ nkpa á, ɔbɔ́hʋlɩ́ɩ mʋ́. Támɛ nɩ́ ɔkʋ lɔ́hʋlɩ́ɩ mʋ nkpa á, ɔbɛ́lanyá mʋ́.
Ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, alɩ ɛkɛ ámʋ onyé á, nɩ́ ahá abanyɔ́ bʋda ɔklan kʋlɛsʋ á, Bulu obótsu ɔkʋlɛ sí ɔkʋlɛ.
“Nɩ́ atsɩ abanyɔ́ bʋdɛ nfúó kwɛ á, Bulu obótsu ɔkʋlɛ sí ɔkʋlɛ.
Yesu akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ, “Anɩ Wíe, nkʋ́nʋ́ ɩbɛ́ba?” Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔtɩ́nɛ́á ɩtɔ wuhɛ́ da a, ɩnʋ́ alása bʋtefia nɩ.”
